blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Camera-based heart rate (HR) and respiratory rate (RR) estimates vary in reliability from window to window, and a common remedy is to fuse several extraction methods with weights from reference-free signal quality indicators. However, few studies test whether these indicators identify the most accurate method in each window or outperform simpler fusion. We evaluate 11 quality indicators and 8 inter-method similarity measures for fusing 7 HR and 10 RR extractors on four public datasets (75 test subjects). Filters, indicator directions, weighting parameters and a learned ridge baseline are selected on a separate five-subject set before testing. Fusion is compared with equal averaging, a constant typical-rate predictor, the best single method selected in advance and in hindsight, and a per-window oracle with a permutation-based null, using subject-level bootstrap confidence intervals. For HR, quality-weighted fusion reduced mean absolute error by 10.9% [5.2, 18.4] relative to averaging and by 15.6% [8.1, 23.1] relative to the method selected in advance, and was statistically indistinguishable from the best method selected in hindsight. Weighting methods by their agreement did not improve on averaging. For RR, the indicators could not identify the more accurate estimates: sharpened quality weighting increased error (-2.6% [-4.8, -0.8]), fused estimates were uncorrelated with the reference (r <= 0.22), and averaging was less accurate than the typical-rate predictor (-3.1% [-6.1, -0.4]). With a second respiratory reference, apparent RR gains reflected estimates moving toward its typical rate. Quality-guided fusion is worthwhile for video HR; for RR, 30-s windows improved estimates but not fusion.
blocks.zh: 基于相机的心率(HR)和呼吸率(RR)估计值在可靠性上因出窗而异,一种常见的补救措施是将几种取出方法从无参考信号质量指标中以权重相接而成. 然而,很少有研究测试这些指标是在每个窗口中找出最准确的方法,还是超越了更简单的聚变. 我们评价了四个公共数据集(75个测试对象)的11个质量指标和8个方法相近度测量,用于引信7个HR和10个RR提取器。 在测试前,在单独的五个主体中选择过滤器、指标方向、加权参数和学习到的山脊基线。 融合被比作等同平均,一个恒定的典型率预测器,是事先和事后选择的最好的单一方法,以及一个以平分法为基础的平分虚空的每道窗道,使用主题级的靴子置信间隔. 就人力资源而言,质量加权聚变将平均绝对误差减少10.9%[5.2,18.4],相对于事先选择的方法减少15.6%[8.1,23.1],在统计学上与事后选择的最佳方法无法区分。 双方同意的加权方法没有改善平均数。 就经常资源而言,指标无法确定更准确的估计数:更清晰的质量加权误差增加(-2.6% [4.8,-0.8]),与参考值无关的引信估计数(r. 0.22),平均率低于典型比率预测值(-3.1% [-6.1,-0.4))。 在第二个呼吸道参考中,经常资源的明显增加反映了向典型比率发展的估计。 对视频HR来说,质量导向聚变是值得的;对RR来说,30s的窗口改进了估计,但没有聚变.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Heart rate (HR) and respiratory rate (RR) are core vital signs. RR in particular is a sensitive early marker of clinical deterioration [ 54 , 28 ] , yet it is the vital sign most often omitted because contact sensors are inconvenient for long-term, home or neonatal monitoring [ 25 , 52 ] . RGB cameras offer a contactless alternative: the cardiac pulse appears as subtle skin colour changes (remote photoplethysmography, rPPG), and breathing appears as motion of the head, shoulders and chest and as modulation of the rPPG waveform [ 11 , 50 , 6 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 心率(HR)和呼吸道(RR)是核心生命征兆. RR尤其是一个敏感的临床恶化早期标记[54,28],但它是最经常被省略的关键标志,因为接触传感器对长期、家庭或新生儿监测不方便[25,52]。 RGB相机提供了一个无接触的可选方案:心动脉冲显示为细微的皮肤颜色变化(远光普雷斯克, rPPG),呼吸显示为头部,肩部和胸部的运动和rPPG波形的调制[11, 50, 6, 4].

blocks.en: Video-derived signals are weak relative to noise, and their quality changes within a recording. One 10-s window may contain a clean oscillation while the next is dominated by head motion, facial expression, illumination change or compression artefacts. No single extraction method dominates across datasets [ 10 , 12 ] , which motivates fusing several methods and weighting each window by a reference-free estimate of its reliability: intrinsic signal quality indices (SQIs) such as spectral signal-to-noise ratio, or extrinsic agreement between methods. In contact photoplethysmography, quality-based selection reduces HR error substantially [ 32 ] , and several video studies report gains from quality-weighted or per-segment method selection [ 3 , 20 , 7 , 17 , 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 相较于噪音,视频生成的信号较弱,其质量在录音内会发生变化. 1-10s窗口可能包含干净的振荡,而下个窗口则以头部运动,面部表情,发光变化或压缩手工业品为主. 没有任何单一的取出方法在数据集[10,12]中占主导地位,这些取出方法激发出几种方法的引信并用对其可靠性的无参考估计对每个窗口进行加权:内在信号质量指数(SQIs),如光谱信号与噪声之比,或方法之间的外接一致. 在接触光谱摄影中,基于质量的选取可以大幅度地减少HR出错[32],一些视频研究报告了从质量加权法或每个片段方法选取中获取的收益[3, 20, 7, 17, 30].

blocks.en: These reports share a gap in how fusion is evaluated. Gains are usually measured against the best single method, chosen on the same test data, without asking how much of the gain any combination would give. Three simpler mechanisms could produce the same gains, and they are rarely ruled out. First, equal averaging of several methods reduces variance without any quality information. Second, when estimates barely correlate with the reference, any method that pulls estimates toward the typical rate lowers error; we call this shrinkage toward the typical rate, and a constant predictor tests it directly. Third, an oracle that picks the estimate closest to the reference in each window reaches a low error simply because it chooses among many candidates, even when no method is more accurate in particular windows; a null oracle, computed after shuffling each method’s estimates across windows, measures that effect. In addition, indicator directions, subsets and weighting parameters are often chosen with access to the test sets, and the reference rate is often computed with the same spectral estimator as the predictions, which makes the agreement look better than it is.
blocks.zh: 这些报告在如何评价核聚变方面存在差距。 收益通常以同一测试数据中选择的最佳单一方法来衡量,而不问任何组合将产生多少收益。 三个较简单的机制可以产生同样的收益,很少被排除在外。 首先,几种方法的等同平均可以减少差异,而没有任何高质量的信息。 第二,当估计数与参考值几乎不相关时,任何将估计数引向典型比率的方法都会降低误差;我们称之为这种向典型比率的收缩,并用恒定预测器直接测试。 第三,一个最接近每个窗口引用的预告片,仅仅因为它在许多候选者中选择了一种低度错误,即使在特定窗口中没有任何方法更准确;一个无效预告片,在将每种方法的预告片排出窗口后计算,可以衡量其效果。 此外,指标方向,子集和权重参数常被选入测试集,而参考率的计算往往与预测值相同的光谱估计值,这使得协议看起来比它更好.

blocks.en: We therefore ask a specific question and test it against these controls: can reference-free quality indicators identify the more accurate method in each window, beyond what equal averaging or predicting the typical rate achieves? We study HR and RR side by side because they differ in signal strength and window content: a 10-s window holds 10–15 heartbeats but only 1–3 breaths. The contributions are: • A controlled evaluation of quality- and similarity-guided fusion for 7 HR and 10 RR extractors on four public datasets, against equal averaging, the median, a constant predictor, the single method chosen in advance and in hindsight, an oracle and a null oracle. All choices, from filter chains to indicator directions, weighting temperature and a learned ridge baseline, are fixed on a held-out five-subject set, and inference uses a subject-level bootstrap. • An analysis of what reference-free indicators know: their usefulness within a method and across methods in the same window, with partial correlations that separate quality information from the predicted rate, and a test of inter-method agreement as an alternative reliability signal. • A task-dependent answer, checked against a second respiratory reference and 30-s RR windows: quality weighting helps HR, whereas for RR the indicators’ weak associations with error did not improve fusion, and apparent fusion gains reduce to shrinkage toward the typical rate.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提出一个具体问题,并对照这些控制进行测试:无参考质量指标能否确定每个窗口中更准确的方法,超出典型比率的等值平均值或预测值? 我们并肩研究HR和RR,因为它们在信号强度和窗口内容上有所不同:一个10到15分的窗口能保持10到15分的心跳,但只有一到3分的呼吸. 贡献是:在4个公共数据集上对7个人力资源和10个RR提取器进行质量和相近性制导核聚变的控制评价,对照平均率、中位数、常数预测器、事先和事后选择的单一方法、甲骨文和无效甲骨文。 所有选择,从过滤链到指标方向、加权温度和学习到的山脊基线,都固定在被搁置的五个主题上,推论使用一个主题级的靴子。 分析无参考指标所知道的:它们在同一窗口中的一种方法内和跨方法内的有用性,部分关联性将质量信息与预测率区分开来,以及作为替代可靠性信号的测试方法间协议. 二. 支助 任务依赖的答案,对照第二个呼吸道参考和30s RR窗口检查:质量加权帮助 HR, 而对于RR, 指标的弱关联有误并没有改善核聚变, 而明显的核聚变增益会减少,

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video-based HR and RR estimation
blocks.zh: 2.1 以视频为基础的人力资源和经常资源估计数

blocks.en: Classical rPPG methods cast pulse extraction as colour-space projection or blind source separation: GREEN uses the green channel [ 48 ] , CHROM projects onto a chrominance plane [ 11 ] , POS applies a plane orthogonal to the skin tone [ 51 ] , and OMIT exploits orthogonality between pulsatile and non-pulsatile components [ 6 ] . Deep models such as EfficientPhys [ 34 ] , PhysFormer [ 53 ] , iBVPNet [ 26 ] and Contrast-Phys [ 45 , 46 ] learn spatiotemporal representations and perform well in distribution, but often underperform classical methods on out-of-distribution data [ 10 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 古典rPPG方法将脉冲取出投射投影或盲源分离:GREEN使用绿色通道[48],CHROM项目入色相平面[11],POS将平面正方形应用到皮肤色调[51],OMIT利用脉冲与非脉冲成分之间的正交感[6]. 高效Phys [34],PhysFormer [53],iBVPNet [26]和Contrast-Phys [45,46] 等深层模型学习了spatiopal phiensions,并在分配中表现良好,但在分配外数据上往往表现不佳的古典方法 [10,12].

blocks.en: Video RR draws on three cues: thoraco-abdominal or head motion tracked by landmarks or optical flow [ 31 , 24 , 2 , 42 , 1 ] , respiratory modulation of the rPPG waveform [ 27 ] , and learned models. In controlled settings, Li et al. [ 31 ] reported over 97% of estimates within 1 breath per minute (brpm) of a contact sensor; in clinical settings, errors are higher: 2.29 brpm in a hospital [ 39 ] and 2.53 brpm in an emergency department with audio–video fusion [ 22 ] . RR in short windows is hard to localise in frequency: a 10-s window has a nominal resolution of 0.1 Hz (6 brpm), so the choice of spectral estimator matters [ 44 , 29 , 37 ] .
blocks.zh: Video RR借鉴了三个提示:由地标或光学流来跟踪的thoraco-abdominal或头部运动[31,24,2,42,1],rPPG波形的呼吸调节[27],和被学习到的模型. 在受控环境下,Li等. [31] 在接触感应器每分钟1个气息(brpm)内报告了超过97%的估计数;在临床环境下,错误较高:医院的2.29 brpm[39],急诊部的2.53 brpm有音频-视频聚变[22]. 短窗口中的RR在频率上很难被定位:一个10s窗口的标称分辨率为0.1Hz (6 brpm),因此光谱估计事项的选择[44,29,37].

blocks.en: 2.2 Signal quality assessment
blocks.zh: 2.2 信号质量评估

blocks.en: Contact PPG has a mature SQI literature. Li and Clifford used SQI-weighted Kalman filtering for robust HR over 6000 hours of ICU recordings [ 32 ] ; Elgendi compared eight SQIs on 106 recordings and found skewness the most discriminative [ 15 ] . Skewness, kurtosis, perfusion and spectral indices recur among the most informative [ 16 , 13 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: Contact PPG拥有成熟的SQI文献. Li和Clifford在超过6000小时的ICU录音中使用SQI加权的Kalman滤波器来进行强健的HR [32];Elgendi在106个录音中比较了8个SQI,发现Skewness是最有歧视性的 [15]. 在信息最丰富的[16.、13.、9]中,摇摆、挥发、渗透和光谱指数不断回升。

blocks.en: For rPPG, frequency-domain SNR is the most widely used index [ 18 , 3 , 49 ] , and Ernst et al. improved HR accuracy by up to 60% with a decision-tree ensemble of six SQIs [ 17 ] . Gao et al. trained an LSTM quality score whose threshold reduced HR MAE from 22.13 to 2.75 bpm [ 19 ] , and Li et al. reported a 29% gain from quality-based segment selection [ 30 ] . The best index differs between contact and video signals: comparing eight SQIs on rPPG, Elgendi et al. found N SQI N_{\mathrm{SQI}} and K SQI K_{\mathrm{SQI}} most informative and the perfusion index uninformative [ 14 ] . Respiratory signal quality has received far less attention: Romano et al. proposed a morphology-based SQI for breath-by-breath RR from wearable sensors [ 41 ] , and no SQI set has been validated for video RR.
blocks.zh: 对rPPG来说,频率域SNR是被最广泛使用的指数[18,3,49],而Ernst等. 将人力资源精确度提高60%,决策树组合为6个SQI[17]。 高等论. 培训了LSTM质量分数,其阈值将HR MAE从22.13 bpm [19] 降低到2.75 bpm,李等. 报告从基于质量的部分选择中获得了29%的收益[30]。 最佳指数在接触和视频信号上有所不同:比较了rPPG上的8个SQI,Elgendi等. 发现N SQI N_{\mathrm{SQI}和K SQI K_{\mathrm{SQI}信息最丰富,而输液指数无信息化[14]. 呼吸道信号质量受到的关注要少得多: 罗曼诺等. 从可穿戴感应器[41]中提出了以形态学为基础的SQI用于呼吸逐呼吸的RR,没有SQI设定用于视频RR的验证.

blocks.en: 2.3 Reliability-aware fusion
blocks.zh: 2.3 可靠性意识聚变

blocks.en: Fusion in rPPG has mostly been spatial, weighting skin regions within one method [ 3 , 33 ] . Method-level fusion, choosing or weighting extraction methods per segment, has been explored for HR: Ghanadian et al. reduced RMSE by 27% at rest and 42% during movement with per-segment method selection [ 20 ] , and Castellano et al. reported 10–20% relative gains from a learned combination of candidate methods [ 7 ] . Earlier preliminary frameworks, including our prior work [ 38 ] , suggested that mapping segment-level quality indices to estimation errors could guide adaptive signal fusion.
blocks.zh: rPPG中的融合大多是空间,在一种方法 [3,33] 内对皮肤进行加权. 已经为HR探索了方法级聚变、选择或加权提取方法:Ghanadian等人在休息时将RMSE减少27%,在移动时将42%的RMSE与每个单元方法选择[20],以及Castellano等人。 (b) 报告从学到的混合候选人方法中获得10-20%的相对收益[7]。 早期的初步框架,包括我们先前的工作[38],建议绘制分层质量指数以估计错误,可以指导适应信号聚合。

blocks.en: All of these gains are measured against a single method or against unfiltered data. To our knowledge, no study of video HR or RR fusion separates the contribution of quality information from that of simple averaging or a typical-rate prior. Oracle selection is commonly used as an upper bound, including in our prior work [ 38 ] , but a minimum over several noisy estimates is optimistic even when the methods carry no complementary information, and the oracle is rarely compared with its chance level; a null-calibrated oracle has only recently been proposed, for thermal HR [ 40 ] . The present study supplies these controls to test whether reference-free quality indicators track window-level error.
blocks.zh: 所有这些收益都是用单一方法或未过滤数据来衡量的。 据我们所知,对视频 " HR " 或 " RR " 组合的任何研究都不能将高质量信息的贡献与简单平均或典型的先发率区分开来。 Oracle选择通常被用作上限,包括在我们之前的作品中[38],但即使这些方法没有包含补充信息,在几个吵闹的估计数之上的最小值也是乐观的,而Oracle很少与它的机会水平相提并论;对于热能HR[40],直到最近才提出一个无效的Oracle. 本研究提供了这些控制,以测试是否无参考质量指标跟踪窗口级别出错.

blocks.en: 3 Quality and similarity framework
blocks.zh: 3 质量和相似性框架

blocks.en: Reliable fusion and filtering require per-window reliability scores that are informative, consistent across heterogeneous extractors and computable without access to the reference. Two sources of reliability information are defined: intrinsic signal quality indicators, computed from the signal of a single method, and inter-method similarity, which quantifies the agreement between the signals extracted by different methods from the same video as an extrinsic reliability proxy. Whether an indicator is useful is tested in two ways, since fusion requires both: the indicator should identify the windows in which a method is inaccurate (within-method), and it should rank the methods correctly within the same window (across-method). Every analysis choice is fixed on a separate five-subject set before any test set is evaluated. Figure 1 summarises the pipeline: signals are extracted from each video, filtered over the full recording, cut into 10-s windows with a 1-s step, converted to rates, scored by quality indicators or inter-method similarity, and fused.
blocks.zh: 可靠的聚变和过滤需要每个窗口的可靠性分数,这些分数是翔实的,在各种提取器之间是一致的,并且可以计算而无需查阅参考文献。 可靠性信息有两个来源被定义:内在信号质量指标,从单一方法的信号中计算,以及方法之间的相似性,它量化了用不同方法从同一个视频中提取的信号与外部可靠性代用器之间的一致. 一项指标是否有用的测试有两种方式,因为聚变需要两种方式:该指标应确定一种方法不准确的窗口(在方法内),并应将方法正确排在同一个窗口(跨方法)内. 每个分析选择都固定在一个单独的五个主体上,然后才对任何测试组合进行评价。 图1汇总了管道:从每段视频中取出信号,在全程录制中过滤,用一等分的步数切入10s窗口,转换为速率,按质量指标或方法相近性打分,并引信.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Quality and similarity framework. Candidate HR and RR signals are extracted by classical, motion-based and deep learning methods, filtered over the full recording, converted to rates in 10-s windows by MUSIC, scored by quality indicators, inter-method similarity or a learned ridge score, and fused or filtered. Steps in the dashed box are fixed on the five-subject Trainset before any test set is evaluated. Fusion is evaluated against a common reference and against averaging, a constant predictor and a null oracle.
blocks.zh: 图1:质量和相似性框架。 候选人HR和RR信号通过古典的,以运动为基础的和深层的学习方法取出,过滤在全录上,由MUSIC转换为10s窗口的速率,按质量指标得分,方法间相似性或学习到的山脊分数,并被熔接或过滤. 在任何测试集被评价之前,破碎盒中的步骤被固定在五个主体的列车集上. 根据共同的参考、平均、恒定的预测器和无效的甲骨文来评价融合。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data and signal processing
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据和信号处理

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Datasets
Four public datasets are used (Table 1 ): OMuSense-23 for model training, indicator selection and testing, and COHFACE, MAHNOB-HCI and StressID for testing only.
blocks.zh: 使用了四个公共数据集(表1):OMuSense-23用于模型培训、指标选择和测试,以及COHFACE、MAHNOB-HCI和应激ID仅用于测试。

blocks.en: OMuSense-23 [ 5 ] contains recordings of 50 subjects performing guided breathing tasks in three poses, captured with an Intel RealSense D435 camera at 30 fps ( 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 pixels), with a CONTEC CMS50E fingertip pulse oximeter and a Vernier Go Direct respiration belt as references. Subjects are split into a deep-learning training set (30 subjects), a validation set (9), an indicator selection set (5 subjects, 15 recordings; called the Trainset and used only for the choices in Section 3.4 , not for training the deep models) and a test set (6 subjects, 18 recordings; OMS-Test ). All choices described in Section 3.4 are made on the Trainset only.
blocks.zh: OMuSense-23 [5]收录了50个主体在3个姿势中执行有导呼吸任务的录音,用一架Intel RealSense D435相机在30英尺(1280×720 1280\times 720像素)被捕获,并有一台CARC CMS50E指尖脉冲氧计和一台Vernier Go Direct呼吸带作为参考. 课程分为深训集(30个科目)、验证集(9)、指标选择集(5个科目,15个录音;称为 " 训练集 " ,仅用于第3.4节的选择,而不是用于培训深训模型)和测试集(6个科目,18个录音;业务管理系统测试)。 第3.4节所描述的所有选择仅由列车组作出。

blocks.en: COHFACE [ 23 ] contains 160 recordings of 39 subjects in two lighting conditions (studio and natural light) at 20 fps, with finger blood volume pulse and a respiration belt; the respiratory reference is the rate series provided with the dataset.
blocks.zh: COHFACE [23]收录了在20英尺平方英尺的两个照明条件下(studio和自然光)的160个39个学科的录音,并有手指血量脉冲和呼吸带;呼吸参考是提供数据集的速率系列.

blocks.en: MAHNOB-HCI [ 43 ] contains recordings of participants watching emotion-eliciting clips at 61 fps ( 780 × 580 780\times 580 pixels), with ECG and a respiration belt. We use 48 sessions from 25 participants; one further session was excluded because its video is shorter than the reference.
blocks.zh: MAHNOB-HCI [43] 收录了61英尺(780×580 780\times 580像素)观看感动片段的参与者的录音,有ECG和呼吸带. 我们使用了来自25名与会者的48场会议;另外一场会议被排除在外,因为它的视频比参考短。

blocks.en: StressID [ 8 ] contains recordings during stress-inducing tasks at 62 fps. We use 60 recordings from five participants with complete video and physiological signals, with ECG and respiration references. With five subjects, StressID results are indicative.
blocks.zh: 压力分解[8]包含在62英尺高空进行压力分解任务时的录音. 我们使用来自五个参与者的60个录音,带完整的视频和生理信号,有ECG和呼吸参考. 有五个主题,压力识别结果可说明问题。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Datasets. Windows are 10 s with a 1-s step. Reference rates are mean ± \pm SD over windows.
blocks.zh: 表1:数据集。 Windows为10 s并有一等阶. 参考率是 ±\pm SD 在窗口上。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Signal extraction
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 取出信号

blocks.en: Facial regions of interest of 72 × 72 72\times 72 pixels are defined from MediaPipe landmarks [ 36 ] . For HR, seven methods are evaluated: four classical (CHROM [ 11 ] , GREEN [ 48 ] , OMIT [ 6 ] , POS [ 51 ] ) and three deep models (PhysFormer, PF [ 53 ] ; the self-supervised Contrast-Phys, CP [ 45 ] ; and the supervised Contrast-Phys + , CP + [ 46 ] ). For RR, ten methods are evaluated: CHROM, GREEN and OMIT (respiratory modulation of the rPPG signal; POS is not used because its 1.6-s normalisation window attenuates the respiratory band); two motion signals from landmark distances [ 1 ] , nose-to-lip (Mot-F) and nose-to-shoulder midpoint (Mot-S); and five deep models (EfficientPhys, EP [ 34 ] ; iBVPNet, IN [ 26 ] ; PF; CP; CP + ). Deep models were trained on the 30-subject OMuSense-23 training split and validated on the 9-subject validation split [ 35 ] , with the contact PPG as the target for HR and the respiration belt as the target for RR in supervised training. Depth is not used, since only OMuSense-23 provides it.
blocks.zh: 从MediaPipe地标上定义了72×7272\times72像素的相干区域[36]. 就人力资源而言,评价了7个方法:4个古典方法(CHROM [11],GREEN [48],OMIT [6],POS [51])和3个深层模型(PhysFormer,PF [53];自控相矛盾-Phys,CP [45];被监管相矛盾-Phys +,CP + [46]). 就RR而言,评价了十种方法:CHROM、GREEN和OMIT(对rPPG信号的呼吸调节;POS没有使用,因为其1.6-s的正态化窗口会减弱呼吸波段);从地标距离取出两个运动信号[1]、从鼻子到嘴(Mot-F)和从鼻子到肩膀的中点取出两个运动信号(Mot-S);以及五个深层模型(EfficentPhys, EP [34];iBVPNet, IN [26];PF;CP;CP+)。 对深层模型进行了关于30个主题的OMuSense-23培训拆分的培训,并对9个主题的验证拆分进行了验证[35],联系人PPG是HR的目标,呼吸带是RR在监督培训中的目标. 深度没有被使用,因为只有OMuSense-23提供.

blocks.en: The deep models were trained at 30 fps. Because a model trained at one frame rate sees a different number of frames per beat at another, all deep models are run at 30 fps: MAHNOB and StressID frames are subsampled and COHFACE frames are upsampled by linear blending of neighbouring frames. Model outputs are interpolated back to the native frame rate. Clips of each model’s native length are processed with 50% overlap, standardised and cross-faded with a Hann window, which removes transients at clip boundaries.
blocks.zh: 深层模型在30英尺高空训练. 由于一个在一帧速率下训练的模型在另一帧时看到每节帧数不同,所以所有深层模型都运行于30英尺:MAHNOB和应力ID帧被分样取出,而COHFACE帧通过相邻帧的线性混合来取出. 模型输出被内插回原生帧率. 每个型号的原生长度的剪接被处理出50%的相重叠,标准化并用汉恩窗口相交叉,在剪接边界上去掉瞬态.

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Signal filtering
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 信号过滤

blocks.en: Filters are applied to the full recording before windowing. The filter chain for each method family was selected on the Trainset from a grid of candidate chains, scored by the mean MAE rank and mean relative excess over the best candidate across methods, all four rate estimators, and both full-recording and window-wise filtering. Among candidates within one percentage point of the best, the chain with the fewest stages was used; when several had the same number of stages, the one that better preserves waveform shape was chosen (Supplement S1). The selected chains are: classical rPPG, median spike removal (0.15 s) and an FIR band-pass (0.7–3.0 Hz); deep rPPG, spike removal, a second-order Butterworth high-pass (0.35 Hz) and the same FIR band-pass; classical respiratory, a second-order Butterworth band-pass (0.08–0.50 Hz) and a Savitzky–Golay smoother (1.5 s, order 3); deep and motion respiratory, the same Butterworth band-pass. Reference signals are filtered with fourth-order Butterworth band-passes (HR 0.7–3.0 Hz; RR 0.08–0.50 Hz).
blocks.zh: 过滤器应用在窗口打开前的完整记录上. 每个方法家族的滤波链是从一个候选链的网格上从Trainset上选取的,其得分是平均MAE等级和相对于最佳方法候选人的相对过量,所有四个速率估测器,以及全程记录和视窗过滤。 在最优一分之内的候选人中,采用了最少数阶段的链;当几个阶段的阶段数量相同时,选择了更好地保存波形形状的链(补充S1)。 选定的链条有:古典RPPG、取出中位钉(0.15 s)和FIR带-通道(0.7-3.0 Hz);深RPPG、取出钉子、二等巴特沃斯高通(0.35 Hz)和同FIR带-通道;古典呼吸道、二等巴特沃斯高通(0.08-0.50 Hz)和萨维茨基高莱平滑道(1.5 s,命令3);深通和运动呼吸道,同为巴特沃斯高通(0.35 Hz)。 参考信号被过滤为第四阶的巴特沃斯波段-通过(HR 0.7–3.0 Hz;RR 0.08–0.50 Hz).

blocks.en: 3.1.4 Rate estimation
blocks.zh: 3.1.4 国家 费率估计

FFT : periodogram zero-padded to a 0.005-Hz grid. Welch : 8.5-s Hamming segments with 78% overlap on the same grid, so that each 10-s window contains only one segment; the segment duration is identical at every frame rate. MUSIC : after mean removal and block-averaging to about four times the upper band edge, a Toeplitz autocorrelation matrix of size M = min ⁡ ( max ⁡ ( 5 , N / 3 ) , 32 ) M=\min(\max(5,N/3),32) is decomposed and the pseudo-spectrum P MUSIC ​ ( f ) = ( ∑ k | 𝐞 k H ​ 𝐚 ​ ( f ) | 2 ) − 1 P_{\mathrm{MUSIC}}(f)=\Bigl(\sum_{k}\bigl|\mathbf{e}_{k}^{H}\mathbf{a}(f)\bigr|^{2}\Bigr)^{-1} (1) is evaluated on a 0.005-Hz grid inside the band, where 𝐞 k \mathbf{e}_{k} are the noise-subspace eigenvectors (signal subspace of dimension 2) and 𝐚 ⁡ ( f ) \mathbf{a}(f) is the steering vector. MUSIC gave the lowest mean MAE on the Trainset for both tasks (HR 7.72 bpm vs. 8.33 FFT, 9.02 Welch, 9.67 Peak; RR 4.39 brpm vs. 4.69, 4.92, 6.08) and is used for all methods and datasets.

MUSIC在列车集上为这两项任务提供了最低平均MAE(HR 7.72 bpm vs 8.33 FFT, 9.02 Welch, 9.67 Peak;RR 4.39 brpm vs 4.69, 4.92, 6.08),并用于所有方法和数据集.

blocks.en: 3.1.5 Reference rates
blocks.zh: 3.1.5 参考费率

blocks.en: One common reference is used per task, computed independently of the methods’ estimator. A reference computed with the same estimator as the predictions shares its frequency grid and biases, which makes errors look smaller than they are (Supplement S2.3).
blocks.zh: 每个任务都使用一个共同的参考,独立于方法的估算器。 用与预测相同的估计值计算出的参考文献分享其频率网格和偏差,使出错看起来比出错小(补编S2.3)。

blocks.en: HR. On contact PPG (OMuSense-23, COHFACE) the reference is the mean beat-to-beat interval in the window. On ECG (MAHNOB, StressID) it is the mean R-R interval from R peaks detected in the QRS band (5–15 Hz) with a prominence threshold and a ± 30 \pm 30 % interval artefact rule; windows need at least 50% beat coverage. The MAHNOB ground-truth signal distributed with our subset used ECG lead EXG1, which had no usable QRS complexes in 16 of 49 recordings; for each recording we used the lead with the highest median QRS prominence (EXG3 in 45, EXG2 in 4; Supplement S2.4). In one StressID recording, narrowband interference was notched before R-peak detection. Against an independent 30-s comparison rate, the beat-interval reference had an MAE of 1.17 bpm (89.5% of windows within 3 bpm), whereas spectral estimates on the same contact signals deviated by 4.5–5.7 bpm (Supplement S2.2).
blocks.zh: 人力资源。 在接触PPG(OMuSense-23,COHFACE)时,参考指窗口中被击打的中位间隔. 在ECG(MAHNOB,压力ID)上,它是QRS波段(5–15 Hz)中检测到的R峰值的平均R-R间隔,有突出阈值和±30\pm 30%的间隔活性能规则;窗口至少需要50%的被拍覆盖. 与我们子集一起分发的MAHNOB地面真象信号使用了ECG铅EXG1,在49个录音中,16个没有可用的QRS复合体;对于每个录音,我们使用了最高中位QRS突出的铅(EXG3 in 45,EXG2 in 4;Supplement S2.4)。 在一次压力分解录中,窄带干扰在R-峰值检测前被标记. 对照独立的30分比较率,节拍间隔参考的MAE为1.17 bpm(3 bpm范围内的窗口占89.5%),而同一接触信号的光谱估计偏差4.5-5.7 bpm(补充S2.2)。

blocks.en: RR. On the belt (OMuSense-23, MAHNOB, StressID), the reference rule was chosen by a check fixed before evaluation: candidate 10-s estimates were compared with breath-local rates from centred 30-s windows, with a bootstrap over recordings. FFT was closer than peak intervals by 1.79 brpm [1.54, 2.03] over the 141 belt recordings of 41 subjects; with a median of only 1–2 breath intervals per 10-s window, peak-based rates were noisy. FFT on the belt is therefore the RR reference. MUSIC was about as close as FFT (MAE 1.28–1.85 vs. 1.30–2.01 brpm across datasets; Supplement S2.2) but was not used, because the methods’ estimates are computed with MUSIC. For COHFACE, the per-window mean of the provided rate series is used. Peak intervals on the belt serve as a second reference in a sensitivity analysis (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 资源。 在带子上(OMuSense-23,MAHNOB,ExpressID),参考规则是在评价前固定的检查中选择的:从30多分左右的中心窗口将候选者10分的估算值与呼吸率-局部比对,在录音上加了靴子. FFT在41个学科的141个带状录音中比峰值间隔更接近于1.79 brpm [1.54, 2.03];中位数每10s窗口只有一到2个气息间隔,基于峰值的速率很吵. 因此,带上FFT是RR的参考. MUSIC与FFT差不多接近(MAE 1.28-1.85 vs. 1.30-2.01 brpm跨数据集;Supplement S2.2),但没有使用,因为方法的估计数是用MUSIC计算的。 对于COHFACE,则使用所提供的费率系列的每窗平均值. 腰带上峰值间隔作为敏感性分析(第5.2节)的第二个参考.

blocks.en: 3.1.6 Windows and metrics
blocks.zh: 3.1.6 视窗和衡量标准

blocks.en: Rates are compared per 10-s window (1-s step) by the mean absolute error (MAE; bpm for HR, brpm for RR) and Pearson’s r r . Windows without a valid reference would be excluded for every method alike; none occurred after the reference corrections above. Because consecutive windows overlap by 90%, all inference is at the subject level.
blocks.zh: 每10s窗口(1-s step)的费率通过平均绝对误差(MAE;Bpm for HR,Brpm for RR)和Pearson的r. 没有有效参考的视窗将同样被排除;在上述参考更正之后没有出现。 因为相接的窗口重叠了90%,所以所有的推断都是在主体层面.

blocks.en: 3.2 Intrinsic quality indicators
blocks.zh: 3.2 综合质量指标

blocks.en: Twelve intrinsic indicators spanning temporal, morphological, spectral, statistical and complexity domains are computed per method and window (Table 2 ) [ 47 , 21 , 9 , 16 , 13 ] , at the sampling rate of the signal: the native frame rate (20–62 Hz) for the classical and motion methods and 30 Hz for the deep models.
blocks.zh: 涉及时间、形态、光谱、统计和复杂领域的12个内在指标按方式和窗口计算(表2)[47、21、9、16、13],按信号的取样率:古典和运动方法的原生帧率(20-62赫兹)和深层模型的30赫兹。

blocks.en: Morphological indicators. For Q TMCC Q_{\mathrm{TMCC}} , each detected peak is the centre of a cycle segment c i c_{i} as long as the median inter-peak interval of the window, so all segments have the same length; segments that would extend beyond the window are skipped. Each segment and the ensemble mean c ¯ \bar{c} are z-scored, and Q TMCC Q_{\mathrm{TMCC}} is the mean Pearson correlation r ⁡ ( c i , c ¯ ) r(c_{i},\bar{c}) , set to 0 when fewer than two complete segments are found. The same procedure is applied to pulse waves for HR and to breaths for RR. The perfusion index Q PerI Q_{\mathrm{PerI}} is computed on the band-pass filtered signal as the median trough-to-peak amplitude divided by the median midline level.
blocks.zh: 口感指标. 对于Q TMCC → mathrm{ TMCC} , 只要窗口的中间峰间间隔, 每一个被检测到的峰值都是周期段c i → i} 的中心, 因此所有段的长度都是一样的; 将延伸出窗口的段被跳过 。 每个段和组合的平均值 c'\bar{c}是z分数,Q TMCC → mathrm{ TMCC}是平均 Pearson 关联 r → (ci, c̄i) r (c_{i},\bar{c}),当找到不到两个完整段时,设置为 0 . 同样的程序适用于HR的脉冲波和RR的呼吸. 在波段-通过过滤的信号上计算出波段指数Q PerI { mathrm{ PerI} 以中位线水平除以槽到峰的中位振幅.

blocks.en: Spectral indicators. For Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} , Q BPR Q_{\mathrm{BPR}} and Q IPR Q_{\mathrm{IPR}} , the recording is filtered with the chain of Section 3.1 , with its band-pass cutoffs widened to [ 0.60 , 3.50 ] [0.60,3.50] Hz for HR and [ 0.07 , 1.00 ] [0.07,1.00] Hz for RR so that harmonics and nearby noise remain in the spectrum, and then cut into the same windows. Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} compares the mean power inside the task band ℬ \mathcal{B} with the mean power outside it, and Q BPR Q_{\mathrm{BPR}} is the fraction of the total power inside ℬ \mathcal{B} ; both use a Welch power spectral density, independent of the rate estimator. Q IPR Q_{\mathrm{IPR}} is the out-of-band fraction of the FFT magnitude spectrum. Q BPR Q_{\mathrm{BPR}} ranks windows exactly as Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} and is excluded from fusion, leaving 11 candidates.
blocks.zh: 光谱指标. 对于 QNR → mathrm{ SNR}}, Q BPR → mathrm{ BPR}}和 Q IPR → mathrm{ IPR}}, 录音用 第 3.1 节的链条过滤,其带-接通截断被拓宽为 [0.60, 350] [0. Hz代表人力资源和[0.07,1.00] [0.07,1.00] Hz表示RR,使口琴和相邻的噪声留在光谱中,再切入同窗. QNR QQMathrm{SNR}}将任务带 B\mathcal{B}内部的正电量与其外的正电量相比较,而Q BPR QMThrm{BPR}}是B\mathcal{B}内部总电量的一小部分;两者都使用Welch电能光谱密度,独立于速率估计器. Q IPR QQ mathrm{ IPR}}是FFT星等谱的出带分. Q BPR QQ mathrm{ BPR}}将窗口排为Q SNR QQ mathrm{SNR}}并被排除在聚变之外,剩下11个入选者.

blocks.en: Statistical and complexity indicators. Q KURT Q_{\mathrm{KURT}} and Q SKEW Q_{\mathrm{SKEW}} are the absolute excess kurtosis and skewness of the window, i.e. the distance from a symmetric, Gaussian-like shape; as for every indicator, whether higher values mean better or worse quality is determined on the Trainset rather than assumed. Q HFD Q_{\mathrm{HFD}} is estimated from the scaling of the curve length L ⁡ ( k ) L(k) with the time step k k , and Q KFD Q_{\mathrm{KFD}} relates the total path length of the signal to its maximum excursion.
blocks.zh: 统计和复杂性指标。 Q KURT → mathrm{ KURT} 和 Q SKEW → mathrm{ SKEW} 是窗口的绝对过量的克特氏和克特氏;即距离对称,高斯形形状相去甚远;与每个指标一样,更高值是否意味着质量更好或更差,由列车集确定而不是假设. Q HFD QQ mathrm{HFD}从曲线长度的缩放L QQ (k) L(k) 与时间步为k k,而Q KFD QQ mathrm{KFD}将信号的总路径长度与其最大出行量联系起来.

blocks.zh: 表2:质量指标和列车设置上推断的方向(下行方向更好,上行方向更好,因为所有五个列车设置科目的标志都不一样) ^ ×\rho_{\times} 是列车集上与绝对错误的交叉方法等级关联( 粗略符号; 负表示较高值与更低错误发生) 。

blocks.en: 3.3 Inter-method similarity
blocks.zh: 3.3 方法之间的相似性

blocks.en: The intrinsic indicators can only detect inconsistency with the expected properties of a physiological oscillation. They cannot detect a signal that is well formed but follows the wrong event, such as a regular head movement. Eight measures therefore quantify how well the signals x x and y y of two methods agree in a window, in three domains.

blocks.en: Evaluation. Fusion is compared with the best single method on each test set ( Baseline , chosen in hindsight and therefore conservative toward fusion), the best single method on the Trainset ( Baseline-train ; HR: PF, RR: Mot-S), the choice a practitioner would make in advance, and the Equal mean and Median , which combine all methods without quality information. For each dataset, MAE is computed over all windows of that dataset, and the difference between two configurations is the relative gain g = ( MAE A − MAE B ) / MAE A g=(\mathrm{MAE}_{A}-\mathrm{MAE}_{B})/\mathrm{MAE}_{A} , so that positive values favour B B . The pooled gain is the unweighted mean of the four per-dataset gains. Datasets are weighted equally because they differ in recording conditions, and subject weighting would let COHFACE (39 of 75 subjects) decide the pooled result. The drawback is that StressID, with only five subjects, carries a quarter of the pooled weight. Confidence intervals (95%, percentile) come from 2000 bootstrap resamples in which subjects are resampled within each dataset. Per-dataset intervals are given in Supplement S8, together with a subject-weighted pooled gain, 1 − ∑ s MAE B ​ ( s ) / ∑ s MAE A ​ ( s ) 1-\sum_{s}\mathrm{MAE}_{B}(s)/\sum_{s}\mathrm{MAE}_{A}(s) over the 75 subjects, with each subject’s MAE taken over its own windows.

blocks.en: Indicator–error association. The association between each oriented indicator and the absolute error is measured with the Spearman correlation (i) within each method across its windows (within-method ρ \rho ), and (ii) across methods within each window, averaged per subject (cross-method ρ \rho ). Positive values mean the indicator is useful. A partial correlation controlling for the predicted rate tests whether an indicator carries information beyond the rate itself. Inference uses one ρ \rho per subject and method, a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test across subjects and Benjamini–Hochberg correction over all indicator–method–dataset cells of a task. The smallest attainable two-sided p p is 0.0625 with five subjects and 0.031 with six, so after correction significance is reachable only on COHFACE (39 subjects) and MAHNOB (25); on the smaller sets the subject-level ρ \rho values are reported descriptively.

blocks.en: Table 2 lists the inferred directions. Only Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} (higher is better) and Q HFD Q_{\mathrm{HFD}} (lower is better) were kept with the same direction for both tasks. Directions inferred without any reference, using the median of the other methods as a pseudo-reference, recovered all five HR pool directions but only two of the four RR directions (Supplement S3). For RR, larger absolute kurtosis went with lower error, the opposite of the assumption that a near-Gaussian shape indicates quality; for HR, its sign was not consistent across the Trainset subjects.

blocks.en: For HR, the pool indicators correlated with a method’s own error: median within-method ρ \rho for Q HFD Q_{\mathrm{HFD}} was 0.10–0.29 on the test sets and for Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} up to 0.26 (OMS-Test). Partial correlations given the predicted rate stayed close to the raw values (e.g. Q HFD Q_{\mathrm{HFD}} 0.15–0.28), so the information is not merely the rate. Removing the 30% of windows with the worst AMM score lowered HR MAE by 11.7–25.1% relative to random removal (Fig. 4 ). On COHFACE and MAHNOB, where tests have power, the within-method correlation survived Benjamini–Hochberg correction in the useful direction for Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} and Q HFD Q_{\mathrm{HFD}} in 3 of 14 method–dataset cells each, and no pool indicator was significant in the harmful direction. Given the predicted rate, most pool indicators reached significance in more cells, not fewer ( Q HFD Q_{\mathrm{HFD}} 11 of 14, Q HJ ​ - ​ M Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}M}} 9, Q TMCC Q_{\mathrm{TMCC}} 6), so the HR information is not a by-product of the estimated rate; Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} fell from 3 cells to 1 and Q HJ ​ - ​ C Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}C}} split (3 useful, 3 harmful; Supplement S6).

blocks.en: For RR, removing the worst 30% by AMM lowered MAE by only 1.0–4.6% relative to random removal. On MAHNOB, where the RR indicators correlated most strongly with error, the correlation largely disappeared once the predicted rate was controlled for: Q HJ ​ - ​ C Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}C}} had a within-method ρ \rho of 0.27 but a partial ρ \rho of 0.03, and Q HJ ​ - ​ M Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}M}} − 0.30 -0.30 and 0.00 (Fig. 5 ). On COHFACE part of the signal remained ( Q HJ ​ - ​ M Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}M}} 0.33 to 0.19), but these indicators were dropped on the Trainset because their sign was not consistent across subjects, and filtering on COHFACE beat random removal by only 2.2%. These indicators describe the frequency content of the waveform, which largely restates the rate the method already estimated. Significance tests make the split between datasets explicit (Supplement S6). blocks.en: Table 3 gives MAE and r r for the ALL group, and Table 4 gives pooled bootstrap gains. The constant and oracle rows are discussed in Section 5.1 .

blocks.en: HR. Equal averaging was worse than the hindsight-best method ( − 19.5 -19.5 % [ − 33.4 -33.4 , − 10.8 -10.8 ]) and no better than the method chosen in advance ( + 4.5 +4.5 % [ − 8.8 -8.8 , 12.0]). Quality information improved on averaging: untuned AMM weighting by 4.9% [2.9, 7.6], Trainset-tuned weighting by 10.9% [5.2, 18.4], and the learned score L-Q by 9.2% [4.1, 15.7]. Tuned weighting improved on Baseline-train by 15.6% [8.1, 23.1] and was not distinguishable from the hindsight-best method ( − 5.2 -5.2 % [ − 12.2 -12.2 , 2.0]); L-Q remained below it ( − 8.0 -8.0 % [ − 14.7 -14.7 , − 2.1 -2.1 ]). The gain over Baseline-train comes mostly from COHFACE and MAHNOB, where the Trainset’s best method (PF) transferred poorly (9.11 and 10.91 bpm) while weighting stayed close to the best available method (7.32 and 7.22).
blocks.zh: 人力资源。 平均率比后视率最佳方法(−19.5-19.5% [−33.4-33.4,−10.8-10.8])差,也不比预先选择的方法(+4.5+4.5% [−8.8-8.8, 12.0])好。 平均率的质量信息有所改善:未调整的AMM加权为4.9% [2.9, 7.6], 列车调整加权为10.9% [5.2, 18.4], 学习得分L-Q为9.2% [4.1, 15.7]。 基线列车的分量提高了15.6%[8.1, 23.1],与后视最佳方法没有区别(-5.2-5.2%[−12.2-12.2,2.0]);L-Q仍然低于它(-8.0-8.0%[−14.7-14.7,−2.1-2.1)。 超过基线列车的收益主要来自COHFACE和MAHNOB,在那里,列车的最佳方法(PF)转移不良(9.11和10.91 bpm),而加权则接近最佳可用方法(7.32和7.22)。

blocks.en: RR. Combining methods reduced error relative to single methods: the equal mean improved on the hindsight-best method by 5.6% [1.9, 9.1] and on Baseline-train by 13.5% [10.5, 16.8]. Quality weighting gave no further improvement. Untuned AMM and Trainset-SMM weighting stayed within 0.2% of the equal mean, while sharper weighting increased error (tuned AMM − 2.6 -2.6 % [ − 4.8 -4.8 , − 0.8 -0.8 ]; L-Q+rate − 1.3 -1.3 % [ − 2.5 -2.5 , − 0.1 -0.1 ]). All fused RR estimates were essentially uncorrelated with the reference ( r r between − 0.11 -0.11 and 0.22).
blocks.zh: 资源。 结合方法减少了与单一方法相比的误差:后视-最佳方法的等值平均值提高了5.6%[1.9, 9.1],基线-列车提高了13.5%[0.5, 16.8]. 质量加权没有进一步改进。 未调整的AMM和Trainset-SMM加权率保持在等值平均值的0.2%以内,而更大幅度地加权误差增加(调整了AMM−2.6-2.6%[−4.8-4.8,−0.8-0.8];L−比率−1.3-1.3%[−2.5-2.5,−0.1-0.1])。 所有经调整的经常资源估计数基本上与参考值无关(r r在0.11-0.11至0.22之间)。

blocks.en: Similarity. Weighting methods by their agreement with the other methods gave the same result as averaging: soft similarity fusion was within 0.4% of the equal mean for both tasks (HR + 0.4 +0.4 % [ − 0.1 -0.1 , 0.9]; RR − 0.2 -0.2 % [ − 0.3 -0.3 , − 0.0 -0.0 ]). Selecting the single most agreeing method was clearly worse than averaging (HR − 21.8 -21.8 % [ − 31.0 -31.0 , − 15.3 -15.3 ]; RR − 10.2 -10.2 % [ − 12.7 -12.7 , − 8.2 -8.2 ]), with the largest HR losses on MAHNOB ( − 30 -30 %) and StressID ( − 27 -27 %). Quality indicators, not agreement, account for the HR gains above.
blocks.zh: 相似相相为相. 与其他方法一致的加权方法得出了与平均值相同的结果:软相似聚变在两项任务的等平均值的0.4%以内(HR+0.4+0.4%[−0.1-0.1,0.9];RR−0.2-0.2%[−0.3-0.3,−0.0-0])。 选择最同意的单一方法显然比平均差(HR−21.8-21.8 % [−31.0-31.0,−15.3-15.3];RR−10.2-10.2 % [−12.7-12.7,−8.2-8.2]),对MAHNOB(−30-30%)和压力指数(−27-27%)的人力资源损失最大。 质量指标(而不是一致指标)是上述人力资源收益的原因。

blocks.en: Weight concentration. At τ = 1 \tau=1 , weights were nearly uniform: the effective number of methods was 6.25–6.33 of 7 for HR and 9.67–9.70 of 10 for RR, which is why untuned AMM rows sit close to the equal mean. The Trainset-tuned temperatures concentrate the weights (about 3.0 effective HR methods and 3.4–3.5 RR methods), which helps HR, where the indicators rank methods, and hurts RR, where they do not. The Trainset curves were consistent with the HR test results but not with the RR ones (Supplement S4): on the Trainset, τ ∗ \tau^{*} lowered HR MAE by 11.2% (6.18 to 5.49 bpm) and RR MAE by 4.1% (3.83 to 3.67 brpm) relative to the equal mean. The HR gain replicated on the test sets (10.9%), whereas the RR gain reversed ( − 2.6 -2.6 %), so the RR temperature was fitted to the five Trainset subjects rather than to transferable quality information. The learned models agree: for HR the largest coefficients were on Q HFD Q_{\mathrm{HFD}} and Q TMCC Q_{\mathrm{TMCC}} , the two indicators with the strongest within-method correlations on the Trainset; three smaller HR coefficients ( Q HJ ​ - ​ M Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}M}} , Q HJ ​ - ​ C Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}C}} , Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} ) took the opposite sign to their directions, consistent with collinearity among the Hjorth and fractal indicators. For RR, Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} carried most of the weight, and neither learned score, with or without the predicted rate, improved on the equal mean.

blocks.en: 5 Fusion gains against controls
blocks.zh: 5 对照控制实现合并收益

blocks.en: The comparisons above are common in fusion studies, but they do not show whether a gain comes from quality information or from the three simpler mechanisms described in Section 1 : variance reduction by averaging, shrinkage toward the typical rate, and the chance advantage of an oracle that chooses among many estimates. This section tests the results of Section 4 against these mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 以上比较在聚变研究中是常见的,但并不显示收益是来自质量信息,还是来自第1节所描述的三种更简单的机制:通过平均减少差异,向典型比率缩小,以及从许多估计中选择神谕的机会优势. 本节对照这些机制检验第4节的结果。

blocks.en: 5.1 Averaging, typical-rate and oracle controls
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 反射、典型率和甲骨文控制

blocks.en: Controls. Constant predicts the Trainset median reference rate (78.95 bpm; 12.52 brpm) in every window. The Oracle picks, per window, the method with the smallest error. The Null oracle , a permutation-based control, recomputes it after permuting each method’s estimates across all windows of the test set, independently for each method and leaving the reference in place, and reports the mean over 200 permutations. It is the error that picking the best of the methods per window reaches by chance, so the difference between Oracle and Null oracle is the part of the oracle’s advantage that comes from each estimate belonging to its own window, rather than from choosing the closest of many estimates by chance. This includes each method’s own tracking of the reference as well as any complementarity between methods. Oracle rows use test labels and are diagnostic only.
blocks.zh: 控制系统 常数预测每个窗口的列车集中位参考率(78.95 bpm;12.52 brpm). 甲骨文选取,每取一取出一取出出最小出错的方法. Null oracle,一种以通量为基础的控制,在将每种方法的估计数渗透到测试集的所有窗口后,对它进行重新计算,对每种方法独立进行,并保留参考,并报告平均超过200个通量。 所以甲骨文和Null oracle之间的区别是甲骨文优势的一部分, 来自于每个属于自己窗口的估计数, 而不是偶然选择许多估计数中最接近的。 这包括每种方法本身对参考的跟踪以及方法之间的任何互补性。 甲骨文行会使用测试标签,并且只是诊断.

blocks.en: HR. The HR fusion results remain above these controls. The equal mean improved on the constant predictor by 24.0% [14.7, 31.4], and quality weighting improved further on the equal mean (Section 4.3 ). The oracle was 0.8–1.1 bpm better than its null on OMS-Test, COHFACE and MAHNOB (e.g. 2.54 vs. 3.60 bpm on OMS-Test) and 0.16 bpm on StressID, so the HR estimates carry window-specific information that a selector can exploit.
blocks.zh: 人力资源。 人力资源整合的结果仍然高于这些控制。 恒定预测器的等值平均值提高了24.0% [14.7, 31.4],质量加权率进一步提高了等值平均值(第4.3节)。 甲骨文比OMS-Test、COHFACE和MAHNOB(如OMS-Test上的2.54比3.60 bpm)和压力识别器上的0.16 bpm要好,因此HR估算中包含了一个选择者可以利用的特定窗口信息。

blocks.en: RR. The constant predictor was more accurate than the equal mean ( − 3.1 -3.1 % [ − 6.1 -6.1 , − 0.4 -0.4 ]); on COHFACE it was more accurate than every method and every fusion rule (2.83 brpm). The improvement from averaging therefore reflects shrinkage toward the typical rate rather than better tracking of breathing: averaging several uncorrelated estimates pulls the result toward the centre of the band, where most true rates lie. The oracle was never more than 0.06 brpm better than its null and was worse on three datasets (e.g. COHFACE 0.90 vs. 0.76 brpm): the null oracle gives no evidence that the RR estimates carry window-specific information, and the low RR oracle error reflects picking the closest of ten estimates by chance. Figure 7 summarises these comparisons.
blocks.zh: 资源。 常数预测器比等值平均值(- 3.1 - 3.1% [- 6.1 - 6.1,- 0.4 - 0.4])更准确;在COHFACE上,它比每一种方法和每一种聚变规则(2.83 brpm)更准确. 因此,与平均率相比的改善反映了向典型速率的收缩,而不是更好地跟踪呼吸情况:平均数个无关的估计将结果拉入最真实速率所在的波段中心。 甲骨文在三个数据集(例如:COHFACE 0.90对0.76 brpm)上从未超过0.06 brpm: 无效的甲骨文没有证据表明RR估计数载有窗口特定信息,低RR甲骨文误差反映的是偶然选择了10个估计数中最接近的. 图7概述了这些比较。

blocks.en: 5.2 Sensitivity to the respiratory reference
blocks.zh: 5.2 对呼吸参考的敏感性

blocks.en: The full RR pipeline was repeated with peak intervals on the belt as the reference. Every Trainset choice was re-derived under this reference with the same procedure: directions and pool, SMM subsets, ridge models, temperature and the constant (Supplement S9). HR was not affected. The two belt references agreed only moderately (spectral vs. peak: r = 0.35 r=0.35 –0.51, MAE 2.7–4.5 brpm), so reference uncertainty in 10-s windows is of the same order as method error. The peak reference also reads higher (Trainset median 14.1 vs. 12.5 brpm). Under it, the Trainset kept eight RR indicators instead of four, adding Q ZCR Q_{\mathrm{ZCR}} , Q HJ ​ - ​ M Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}M}} , Q HJ ​ - ​ C Q_{\mathrm{HJ\text{-}C}} , Q PerI Q_{\mathrm{PerI}} and Q KFD Q_{\mathrm{KFD}} and dropping Q KURT Q_{\mathrm{KURT}} ; the Hjorth, zero-crossing and Katz indicators had cross-method ρ \rho of 0.21–0.28 on the Trainset.
blocks.zh: 整个RR管道被重复使用,并用带上最高峰间隔作为参考. 每一列列车的选用都在此参考下以相同的程序重新产生:方向和池,SMM子集,山脊模型,温度和常数(补充S9). 人力资源没有受到影响。 两种带状参考只商定中度(光谱对峰:r=0.35 r=0.35–0.51,MAE 2.7–4.5 brpm),因此10s窗口中的参考不确定性与方法错误的顺序相同. 峰值参考文献也读取了更高的(Trainset中位数 14.1 vs 12.5 brpm.). 在它下面,列车集保留了8个RR指标而不是4个,增加了Q ZCR → mathrm{ ZCR}},Q HJ - M → mathrm{HJ\text{-}M}},Q HJ - C → mathrm{HJ\text{-}C}}, QPERI QQMThrm{PERI}和 QFD QMThrm{KFD} 并丢出 QKURT QMThrm{KURT} ; Hjorth, 0-cross and Katz 指标在列车集上有 ^ 0.21–0.28 的相交方法.

blocks.en: Quality weighting then lowered RR error relative to averaging (L-Q+rate 11.2% [5.0, 16.0]; Trainset-SMM 4.5% [2.4, 6.2]), but three observations show that the gain is not quality information. First, every fused estimate remained uncorrelated with the reference ( r ≤ 0.17 r\leq 0.17 ), and none outperformed the constant predictor on average over the four datasets (equal mean vs. constant − 21.8 -21.8 % [ − 27.3 -27.3 , − 16.7 -16.7 ]). Second, the weighted estimates moved toward the constant rather than toward the reference (e.g. MAHNOB: tuned AMM 4.36 vs. constant 4.31 brpm), and the newly kept indicators had within-method correlations close to zero once the predicted rate was controlled for (Trainset partial ρ \rho − 0.13 -0.13 to 0.09; − 0.04 -0.04 to 0.02 on MAHNOB and StressID). Weighting that favours methods whose estimates lie near the reference’s typical level produces exactly this pattern. Third, on COHFACE, whose rate-series reference is the same in both analyses, these indicators pointed the wrong way (cross-method ρ \rho − 0.14 -0.14 to − 0.01 -0.01 ) and the same weighting increased error (tuned AMM 4.29 vs. 3.03 brpm for the equal mean).

blocks.en: 6 Indicator usefulness for HR and RR
blocks.zh: 6 对人力资源和经常资源有用的指标

blocks.en: A 10-s window holds 10–15 heartbeats but only 1–3 breaths. With many cycles, waveform regularity ( Q TMCC Q_{\mathrm{TMCC}} ), spectral concentration ( Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} ) and complexity ( Q HFD Q_{\mathrm{HFD}} ) describe whether a clean periodic signal is present, and a clean periodic signal usually gives the right rate. With one or two cycles, the same measures may mainly describe the frequency content of the window, which is the rate the method already estimated.
blocks.zh: 一个10到15分的窗口 保持了10到15分的心跳 但只有1到3分的呼吸 随着多周期,波形正态(Q TMCC QQ mathrm{TMCC} ),光谱浓度(Q SNR QQ mathrm{SNR})和复杂度(Q HFD QQ mathrm{HFD})描述是否有干净的周期信号,干净的周期信号通常给出正确的速率. 有了一两个周期,同样的度量可能主要描述出窗口的频率内容,即已经估计的速率.

blocks.en: The partial correlations make this concrete: the strongest RR indicator effects (MAHNOB) vanished once the predicted rate was controlled for, whereas most HR effects persisted or grew. Where RR indicators did carry information beyond the rate (COHFACE), it was too weak to rank methods. The reference itself is also uncertain in short windows: the two belt references disagreed by 2.7–4.5 brpm at 10 s and by 1.5–3.1 brpm at 30 s.
blocks.zh: 部分关联使得这一具体因素:一旦预测率得到控制,最强的经常资源指标效应(MAHNOB)就消失了,而大多数人力资源效应则持续存在或增加。 如果经常资源指标所传递的信息超过比率(COHFACE),则过于薄弱,无法对方法进行排名。 参考材料本身在短窗中也不确定:两个带状参考材料在10s时为2.7-4.5brpm,在30s时为1.5-3.1brpm。

blocks.en: Window length limits the RR estimates but is not the only constraint: with 30-s windows the estimates, the reference and Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} all improved, yet no indicator ranked methods well enough for fusion to beat averaging. These results support an influence of cycle count but do not establish a sufficient window length or number of cycles for RR quality assessment. Indicators that assess breathing itself, such as breath-by-breath morphology [ 41 ] , breath-based windows and more accurate references may provide information that the evaluated indicators miss.
blocks.zh: 窗口长度限制 RR 估计, 但并非唯一的制约因素: 估计值为 30-s 窗口, 参考值和 Q NR { mathrm{ SNR} 都改进了, 然而没有指标排列得足够好, 可以击败平均值 。 这些结果支持周期计数的影响,但没有为经常资源质量评估确定足够的窗口长度或周期数。 评估呼吸本身的指标,如气相通的呼吸形态[41],以呼吸为基础的窗口和更准确的引用,可以提供被评价的指标错过的信息.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Quality weighting is useful for HR. HR indicators identified a method’s inaccurate windows (filtering 12–25% better than random) and ranked methods within a window (cross-method ρ \rho up to 0.30), and the per-window oracle beat its null. With weights fixed on five subjects, tuned weighting reduced HR error by 11% relative to averaging and by 16% relative to the method a practitioner would have chosen in advance. The practical value is that the result depends less on that choice: the Trainset’s best method failed to transfer to COHFACE and MAHNOB, while quality weighting stayed close to whichever method was best on each dataset. Fusion did not beat the best method chosen in hindsight, and should not be expected to when one method clearly dominates.
blocks.zh: 质量权重对人力资源有用。 人力资源指标确定了一种方法不准确的窗口(过滤率比随机率高12-25 % ) , 并在窗口内对方法进行排名(交叉方法为\rho到0.30),每个窗口的甲骨文都比它无效。 5个科目的权重固定后,调整权重将人力资源误差比平均值减少11%,比从业者事先选择的方法减少16%。 实际价值是,结果较少取决于这一选择:Trainset的最佳方法未能转至COHFACE和MAHNOB,而质量加权则接近于每个数据集的最佳方法。 Fusion没有击败后视所选的最佳方法,当一种方法明显占据主导地位时,不应该指望它.

blocks.en: For RR, apparent fusion gains reflect shrinkage. Averaging RR estimates reduced error relative to single methods by 6–14%, but the constant predictor outperformed averaging, the oracle was no better than its null, every fused estimate had r ≤ 0.22 r\leq 0.22 , and sharpening the weights made results worse. Under a second reference, weighting appeared to help, but only by moving estimates toward that reference’s typical level; the same weights hurt on a dataset with an independent reference. A practitioner who reads an RR fusion gain as evidence of quality information would be misled; comparing with a constant predictor and a null oracle exposes this.
blocks.zh: 对于RR来说,明显的聚变增益反映了收缩. 预测RR比单一方法的误差减少了6–14%,但恒定预测器的性能超过了平均值,预告器的性能并不比它的无效好,每一次引信估计有 r 0.22 r\ leq 0.22 , 并磨削重量使结果更差。 在第二个参考文献中,权重似乎有所帮助,但只能通过将估计值移到该参考文献的典型水平;同样的权重会伤害到独立参考文献的数据集。 将RR聚变收益视为质量信息证据的从业者会被误导;与常数预测器作比较,而一无是处的甲骨文就暴露了这一点.

blocks.en: Agreement and averaging. A method’s mean similarity to the others measures its distance from the consensus, and the equal mean already estimates the consensus; soft agreement weighting therefore returns close to the average. Selecting only the most agreeing method keeps the consensus but loses the error reduction that averaging gives. When the methods share an error, agreement also rewards that error: all HR methods compressed estimates toward 70–80 bpm (Fig. 3 ), so the method closest to the others is not the one closest to the truth. This is consistent with hard selection losing most on MAHNOB and StressID, but it remains an interpretation. Consensus is not useless: as a pseudo-reference it recovered all five HR indicator directions without labels (Section 4.2 ). Agreement can therefore help decide which indicators to trust, but weighting methods by agreement gives little more than averaging.
blocks.zh: 协议和平均。 一种方法与其他方法的间接相似性衡量了它与共识的距离,而平等的平均值已经估计了共识;因此,软协议的权重与平均值接近。 只选择最同意的方法保持共识,但丧失平均误差的减少。 当方法共享错误时,协议也奖励了这个错误:所有的HR方法将估计压缩到70-80 bpm(图3),因此最接近其他方法并不是最接近真理的方法。 这与在MAHNOB 和 ExpressID 上失去最多的困难选择是一致的,但它仍然是一种解释。 共识并非无用:作为伪参考,它恢复了所有五个没有标签的人力资源指标方向(第4.2节)。 因此,协议有助于决定哪些指标值得信任,但通过协议加权方法给予的只是平均。

blocks.en: Methodological lessons. Two controls changed our conclusions during this work and should be standard. A common reference computed independently of the methods’ estimator: an estimator-matched reference lowered RR MAE by up to 0.7 brpm for MUSIC and 1.2 brpm for Peak (Supplement S2.3). A constant predictor and a null oracle: without them, the RR results would have read as successful fusion with complementary methods.
blocks.zh: 方法方面的经验教训。 在这项工作中,有两项控制措施改变了我们的结论,应当成为标准措施。 一种与方法的估算标准独立计算的共同参考标准:一个估算标准匹配的参考标准将RR MAE降低到MUSIC的0.7 bpm和峰值的1.2 bpm(补充S2.3)。 一个恒定的预测器和一个无效的预言器:没有这些预言器,RR结果就会被读作是用互补方法成功融合.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: The Trainset, OMS-Test and StressID have five, six and five subjects; subject-level tests on these sets cannot reach significance after correction. Because pooled estimates weight the four datasets equally, StressID carries a quarter of the pooled weight; weighting every subject equally instead (a ratio of summed per-subject MAEs, in which COHFACE and MAHNOB hold about four-fifths of the weight) does not change which configuration is better in any comparison, but reduces the HR gain of tuned weighting over averaging from 10.9% to 7.9% [2.9, 13.5], because that gain is absent on COHFACE and largest on OMS-Test, whose share falls to 7% (Supplement S8). HR was evaluated in 10-s windows only; RR was evaluated in 10-s and 30-s windows, but not with longer windows or breath-by-breath segmentation, and the 30-s analysis also changed the RR estimator and reference, so the effect of window length alone cannot be isolated. Filtering is offline over the full recording; causal, real-time filtering was not evaluated. Deep models were trained at 30 fps on OMuSense-23 and run at that rate by resampling; models trained on each dataset’s native rate might behave differently. All HR methods compress the rate range toward 70–80 bpm, and fusion cannot correct an error that all candidates share. Finally, the reference rules were validated against longer-window rates from the same contact sensors rather than against manual annotation.
blocks.zh: 列车集、业务管理系统测试和压力 ID有5个,6个和5个科目;这些套的科目水平测试在校正后无法达到意义. 由于集合估计值对四个数据集的权重相等,压力识别值承担四分之一的权重;对每个主体的权重相等(每个主体的权重总和比率,其中COHFACE和MAHNOB持有约五分之四的权重)并不改变哪个配置在任何比较中都更好,而是将调取权重的人力资源收益从平均10.9%降至7.9%[2.9, 13.5],因为COHFACE没有这一收益,而OMS-Test的比重也最大(补充S8)。 HR只在10s窗口中被评价;RR在10s和30s窗口中被评价,但不具有更长的窗口或逐气分解,而30s分析也改变了RR的估测和参考,因此单是窗口长度的效果不能被隔离. 过滤在全程记录中脱机;因果,实时过滤没有被评价. 深层模型在OMuSense-23上接受了30英尺的训练,并且通过再取样以这个速度运行;对每个数据集本土率的模型进行培训的模型可能表现不同. 所有HR方法将速率范围压缩到70-80 bpm,而聚变无法纠正所有候选者共有的错误. 最后,参照规则是对照同一接触传感器的较长窗口率,而不是对照人工注释来验证的。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Reference-free quality indicators help video-based HR fusion: with all choices fixed in advance, quality weighting reduced HR error by 11% relative to averaging and by 16% relative to the method chosen in advance, approaching the best method chosen in hindsight. For RR in 10-s windows, no indicator improved fusion; averaging helped only by shrinking toward the typical rate, a constant predictor did better, and apparent quality gains under a second reference reflected estimates moving toward that reference’s typical rate rather than better signal quality. Lengthening RR windows to 30 s improved the estimates and the reference but not quality-guided fusion, even with Q SNR Q_{\mathrm{SNR}} restored to the pool. Evaluations of quality-guided fusion should report equal averaging, a constant predictor and a null oracle alongside the best single method, with choices fixed before testing and a reference independent of the methods’ estimator.
blocks.zh: 无参考质量指标有助于基于视频的人力资源融合:在事先确定所有选择后,质量权重将人力资源误差相对于平均值减少了11%,相对于事先选择的方法减少了16%,接近后视所选最佳方法. 在10s窗口的RR中,没有指标改善聚变;平均只有缩小到典型速率,一个恒定预测器才能做得更好,在第二个参考中,明显的质量收益反映了朝着该参考的典型速率而不是更好的信号质量前进的估计数。 将 RR 窗口延长至 30 s , 改善了估计和参考, 但没有质量导向的聚变, 即使Q SNR QQ mathrm{ SNR}}已恢复到池中 。 对质量指导性聚变的评估应该报告平均率相等、连续预测器和与最佳单一方法并列的无效预言器,在测试前确定选择,以及独立于方法估计器的参考。

blocks.en: S2.4 MAHNOB-HCI ECG lead
blocks.zh: S2.4 MAHNOB-HCI ECG 领导

blocks.en: The ground-truth ECG distributed with our MAHNOB-HCI subset was lead EXG1. Its median QRS prominence was below 5 in 16 of 49 recordings (sessions 556, 560, 688, 1042, 1698, 1700, 2114, 2120, 2736, 2740, 3136, 3152, 3514, 3522, 3778, 3794), where R peaks could not be detected reliably. The 49 recordings include the session later excluded because its video is shorter than the reference (48 are analysed). For every recording, the lead among EXG1–EXG3 with the highest median QRS prominence was used instead (EXG3 in 45 recordings, EXG2 in 4), cropped exactly as the original signal (30-s pre-stimulus offset, verified by correlation with the stored signal). In one StressID recording, narrowband interference near 6 Hz masked the QRS complex; spectral lines were notched before R-peak detection, applied only when no QRS could be detected otherwise.
blocks.zh: 与MAHNOB-HCI子集一起分发的地面实况ECG是领先的EXG1. 它的QRS中位值在49个录音中(会话556起,560起,688起,1042起,1698起,1700起,2114起,2120起,2736起,2740起,3136起,3152起,3514起,3522起,3778起,3794起)有16起低于5起,R峰无法可靠地探测出. 49个录音包括后来被排除在外的会话,因为其视频比参考短(48个被分析出). 每次录制时,均取而代之的是QRS中位值最高的EXG1-EXG3(EXG3收录于45个录音中,EXG2收录于4个录音中)的领先位置,完全按照原始信号收录(30-s前刺激相抵消,由所存储信号的关联性验证). 在一次压力识别记录中,6赫兹附近的窄带干扰掩盖了QRS综合体;光谱线被标记在R-峰值探测之前,只有在无法在其他情况下检测出QRS时才适用.
